subject: Insurance
title: War Exclusions and Lloyd's of London
description: A micro-lesson that makes War Exclusions and Lloyd's of London usable.

buildup.text: Lloyd's of London writes specialty war risk policies—but at extreme premiums.

discovery.text: War risk premiums for the Black Sea surged 10,000% after Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022.

twist.text: The Ukraine conflict trapped billions in insured aircraft. Lessors had planes in Russia that couldn't be retrieved.

climax.text: War exclusions exist because warfare destroys faster than any pool can pay.

punchline.text: 10,000% premium surge. War makes insurance nearly impossible to price.

quiz.question: Why do standard insurance policies exclude war?
options: Mass destruction from war is uninsurable by private markets
